note: GFP recreation area on the Lewis & Clark Lake boat basin, 1 mi E of Springfield off SD-37: a row of electric sites along the basin's grassy east bank, a shaded inner row, and a separate wooded north loop with 50-amp sites; one tent site and two camping cabins. Boat ramp, fishing dock, fish-cleaning station; a bike trail runs to town. In winter only the north loop stays open. Lakefront at 04E, 06E, 08E and 10E. --Claude
